page.layout: One page of the scan: a blank endpaper-like leaf with only handwriting and a digitiser's shelf mark; no printed text block, no margin notes.
page.notes: The page carries only manuscript annotations and a digitiser's mark, which are not printed text and are therefore not transcribed: a pencilled shelf-type mark "14.2.2", "S per Eych.", the ownership inscription "Thomas F. Torrance" in ink, "Opera" and "Ex" written in ink at right, and the stamp-like code "SCS #1536" at the foot. Torn paper and brown staining at the top and edges are damage, not text. No printed page number, running head, catchword or signature is present.
